data.exact_reserve_text: Across all classes combined we had a net reserve release of GBP 1m in 2019. In 2018 we had a net reserve strengthening of GBP 1m. The reserve release was due to the Property and PCR accounts partially offset by deterioration in the Professional Liability, Financial Institutions and Accident & Health classes.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reserve release in Property and PCR accounts
prior_year_events.impact_description: The report states the reserve release was due to the Property and PCR accounts (favourable development), partially offsetting other deterioration.

prior_year_events.event_name: Deterioration in Professional Liability, Financial Institutions and Accident & Health classes
prior_year_events.impact_description: The report states deterioration in these classes partially offset the Property/PCR release.

named_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of 2017 and prior underwriting years
named_events.loss_description: Effective 1 January 2020 Syndicate 2015 placed the RITC of the liabilities of the 2017 and prior underwriting years with a third-party Lloyd's syndicate. This transaction results in the transfer from Syndicate 2015 of gross and net technical provisions of GBP 184.6 million and GBP 110.8 million respectively.

data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development table, Syndicate 2015 shows an overall gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 30.34m (about 8.7% of opening gross claims outstanding). The Managing Agent's report notes a small net release after reinsurance, driven by favourable development on Property and Political & Credit Risk (PCR) accounts but partially offset by deterioration in Professional Liability, Financial Institutions and Accident & Health. A subsequent third-party RITC (effective 1 Jan 2020) transfers 2017 & prior liabilities out of the syndicate.
raw_causal_phrases: net reserve release of GBP 1m in 2019
The reserve release was due to the Property and PCR accounts partially offset by deterioration in the Professional Liability, Financial Institutions and Accident & Health classes

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was not stated explicitly as a gross movement in the notes. Gross PYD was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 37-38). The Managing Agent narrative reports a small NET reserve release of GBP 1m (net of reinsurance) which differs in sign from the gross PYD calculated here. A subsequent RITC (effective 1 Jan 2020) transfers GBP 184.6m gross (and GBP 110.8m net) of 2017 & prior technical provisions out of the syndicate which materially affects comparability. 'PCR' abbreviation mapping to a standard LOB is ambiguous; mapped here to Reinsurance - Specialty for reporting purposes. Aviation shows a small negative premium (-GBP 2k) in the segmental table.
